department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
notes: New B.S. launched Fall 2025, offered by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (Jacobs School of Engineering); major code CSE-BS-004; selective major. Source: UCSD General Catalog, BS Artificial Intelligence section (catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/CSE-ug.html). Per the CSE department's Fall 2026 Undergraduate Course Updates (cse.ucsd.edu, updated September 21, 2026): the AI major is not an option for the Selective Major Process in 2026-27; CSE majors in CSE-BS-001/002/003 may not switch into CSE-BS-004 during 2026-2027 (all requests denied); CSE-BS-004 majors may switch into another CSE major without restriction but cannot switch back until the policy is revisited. All major requirements must be completed with a C- or better; a maximum of 12 units of P/NP special-studies courses may count (max 8 units CSE 198/199/199H, max 4 units CSE 197, max 2 units CSE 109). Total 124 units (60 lower-division + 64 upper-division).

requirements.name: Lower-division CS core
requirements.note: CSE 8B or CSE 11; CSE 15L or CSE 29; CSE 20 or MATH 15A/31CH/109; CSE 21 or MATH 154/158/184/188
requirements.note_zh: CSE 8B 或 CSE 11；CSE 15L 或 CSE 29；CSE 20 或 MATH 15A/31CH/109；CSE 21 或 MATH 154/158/184/188

requirements.name: Lower-division CS: min 4 units from list
requirements.name_zh: 低年级 CS：从清单至少修 4 学分
requirements.note: Minimum 4 units; any CSE upper-division course not used elsewhere also counts. Catalog list omits CSE 25 (unlike the CS major list).
requirements.note_zh: 至少 4 学分；未在别处使用的任意 CSE 高年级课也可计入。目录清单中没有 CSE 25（与 CS 专业清单不同）。

requirements.name: Lower-division Artificial Intelligence
requirements.note_zh: 人工智能方向：CSE 25、CSE 55（共 8 学分）

requirements.name: Lower-division Mathematics (16 units)
requirements.note: MATH 20C or MATH 31BH; MATH 18 or MATH 31AH
requirements.note_zh: MATH 20C 或 MATH 31BH；MATH 18 或 MATH 31AH

requirements.name: General Science (one course, 4 units)
requirements.name_zh: 通识科学（一门，4 学分）

requirements.name: Upper-division Core (20 units)
requirements.note: Data structures/programming: CSE 100 or CSE 100R; Algorithms: CSE 101; Artificial Intelligence: CSE 150A or CSE 150B or CSE 151B; Machine Learning: CSE 151A; Deep Learning: CSE 151B. Catalog states 20 units; CSE 151B is listed both as the Deep Learning core course and as an option for the Artificial Intelligence core line.
requirements.note_zh: 数据结构/编程：CSE 100 或 CSE 100R；算法：CSE 101；人工智能：CSE 150A 或 CSE 150B 或 CSE 151B；机器学习：CSE 151A；深度学习：CSE 151B。目录总学分为 20；CSE 151B 同时出现在深度学习核心课与人工智能核心课的选项中。

requirements.name: AI Electives (12 units)
requirements.note: 12 units (3 courses of 4 units), not used to satisfy other core or breadth elective requirements
requirements.note_zh: 共 12 学分（3 门，每门 4 学分），不得与核心课或广度选修重复计入

requirements.name: Upper-division Electives (28 units with breadth)
requirements.name_zh: 高年级选修（28 学分，含广度要求）
requirements.note: 28 units: >=8 Systems-tagged, >=8 Theory/Abstraction-tagged, >=8 Applications-tagged, +4 additional. Count=7 assumes 4-unit courses; see catalog for tag lists. Any CSE upper-division course 100-194 not used elsewhere counts except CSE 180/180R and CSE 191.
requirements.note_zh: 共 28 学分：Systems 类 ≥8、Theory/Abstraction 类 ≥8、Applications 类 ≥8，另加 4 学分。门数按每门 4 学分估算为 7 门；标签清单见官方目录。未在别处使用的任意 CSE 高年级课（100–194）均可计入，CSE 180/180R 与 CSE 191 除外。
